name: La Mijoterie du Roy Henri
description: The grandest dining venue at Puy du Fou — an 800-seat Renaissance banquet hall serving quality French regional cuisine developed with Michelin-starred chef Yannick Alleno. Advance booking essential.

items.name: Menu Renaissance Adult
items.description: 3-course set menu with Vendee regional starter, main course and dessert

items.name: Menu Enfant
items.description: Children's 3-course menu with smaller portions

items.name: Plat du Jour
items.description: Daily changing main course using seasonal Vendee produce

items.name: Muscadet Wine
items.description: Glass of local Loire Valley Muscadet white wine

name: Le Cafe de la Madelon
description: The most unique restaurant concept in European theme parks — waitstaff are also performers who break into song and theatre between courses in a perfectly recreated 1914 French village cafe. Book well in advance.

items.name: Formule Madelon
items.description: Set menu — onion soup, cassoulet and tarte tatin

items.name: Croque Monsieur Soldat
items.description: Classic toasted ham and cheese with salad

items.name: Tarte Tatin Maison
items.description: Classic French upside-down apple tart with creme fraiche

items.name: Cidre Vendeen
items.description: Traditional Vendee cider in earthenware pitchers

name: Le Bistrot
description: A classic French bistro serving fresh seasonal dishes, salads and daily specials — the most relaxed and accessible dining at Puy du Fou, ideal for a lighter lunch between shows.

items.name: Planche Charcuterie
items.description: Board of local Vendee charcuterie, pickles, bread and butter

items.name: Salade Mixte
items.description: Fresh mixed salad with goat cheese, walnuts and honey dressing

items.name: Croque Madame
items.description: Classic toasted sandwich with ham, cheese and fried egg

items.name: Cafe Gourmand
items.description: French espresso served with three miniature desserts

name: L Ecuyer Tranchant
description: Medieval banquet restaurant in a stone-vaulted great hall by torchlight — roasted meats, rich stews and goblets of wine served by costumed staff. Part of La Citadelle hotel, open to day visitors with advance booking.

items.name: Banquet du Chevalier
items.description: Full medieval menu — herb soup, roasted chicken, vegetable pottage and honey cake

items.name: Gigot d Agneau
items.description: Slow-roasted Vendee lamb with root vegetables and rosemary jus

items.name: Soupe des Serfs
items.description: Hearty medieval vegetable and barley soup with crusty bread

items.name: Hypocras
items.description: Spiced medieval wine in an earthenware goblet

name: L Atrium
description: The Villa Gallo-Romaine hotel restaurant with mosaic floors, frescoes and open courtyard. Expanded in 2026 with authentic Neapolitan wood-fired pizzas alongside the Mediterranean menu.

items.name: Breakfast Buffet
items.description: Full hot and cold breakfast buffet for hotel guests

items.name: Pizza Napolitaine
items.description: Authentic Neapolitan pizza with wood-fired crust — new 2026

items.name: Tartare de Saumon
items.description: Fresh salmon tartare with lemon dressing and capers

items.name: Tiramisu Maison
items.description: Classic homemade tiramisu with espresso and mascarpone

name: L Auberge du Peuple
description: A traditional Vendee village tavern serving honest regional cooking — duck confit, buckwheat galettes and artisan cider. The most informally priced restaurant at Puy du Fou, perfect for families.

items.name: Confit de Canard
items.description: Duck confit with Vendee mogettes beans and potatoes sarladaises

items.name: Galette de Ble Noir
items.description: Traditional buckwheat crepe with cheese, ham and egg

items.name: Soupe Paysanne
items.description: Rustic country vegetable soup with bread and butter

items.name: Cidre Artisanal
items.description: Local artisan Vendee cider from the barrel
